title: AI products & agents
description: For product and operations teams building conversational experiences or workflows that interpret information and take actions.

headline.before: Useful AI, connected to the work.

whyText: For product and operations teams building conversational experiences or workflows that interpret information and take actions.
checks: Conversational products, voice, and contextual memory
Tool calling and integration with business systems
Evaluation datasets and quality feedback loops

faq.question: Do we need to replace our existing tools?
faq.answer: We start with the systems you already use. Integrations can connect them; custom software fills gaps where existing tools do not fit the workflow.

faq.question: Who owns the software and how is it handed over?
faq.answer: Ownership, access, and third-party licenses are agreed in the engagement scope. Our delivery approach includes documentation, a walkthrough, and an operating runbook so your team can understand and operate the system.

faq.question: How do you handle sensitive data and AI decisions?
faq.answer: We scope access, deployment, data handling, and approval requirements before building. Depending on the workflow, safeguards can include evaluation datasets, confidence thresholds, audit logs, human review, and self-hosted components. Self-hosting a workflow does not by itself keep data out of external model APIs.

faq.question: How much does an engagement cost?
faq.answer: The introductory 15-minute call is free. Diagnostic audits, implementation, and ongoing partnerships are quoted to scope. We agree deliverables, milestones, fees, and the delivery schedule before work starts.

faq.question: What happens after launch?
faq.answer: The scope defines handover and post-launch responsibilities. Ongoing maintenance, improvements, or an embedded technical partnership can be arranged separately, with support coverage and response expectations agreed for your systems.

pricing.headline: Quoted to scope
pricing.detail: A free 15-minute introduction. Fees, deliverables, and schedule are agreed before further work.
